## LEGAL COMPLIANCE

Under the **Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173)** and **GDPR Article 6(1)(a)**, the pilot has provided explicit consent for this verification. Your institution is legally protected to confirm these records under this authorization.

**Veremark's Role:** Veremark is a regulated background screening provider operating under applicable data protection laws. We do not request open-ended records — only confirmation of the specific data points listed above.

**Data Handling:** All verified data is stored in the pilot's personal **Verepass wallet**, a blockchain-backed digital credential passport controlled entirely by the pilot. You are not transferring data to a third party — you are confirming records that the pilot already owns.
